rawIdentityPolicy: retain raw title and canonical target; presentation does not infer hierarchy/readability/order

titleForms.numeric: ASCII/fullwidth digits, preserving leading zeroes; no digit-length boundary
titleForms.ordinal: only a complete Arabic numeric ordinal with 话/回/章/集 and no subtitle
titleForms.parts: ordinal or number plus 上/中/下; complete mixed ASCII/fullwidth parentheses or middle dot accepted
titleForms.named: real subtitle, special chapter, volume, malformed/ambiguous label retained

sourceMetadataPolicy: source-bound evidence only; isVip/isPay remain independent optional values, never infer navigation permission
searchPolicy: full row with complete ancestor context; raw/display aliases searchable

layoutPolicy.numeric: stable width budget; long outlier changes its own container only
layoutPolicy.paging: retain canonical anchor and subsequent grid phase

visualPolicy: existing palette/typography/geometry; source status uses existing meta text style; no new colored tag system
historicalNamedFixture: original 306 日月同错 rows remain unavailable; actual Tencent named titles retained here

sourceFlagSemantics.missing: unknown; do not default wire metadata to false
